gaps: Idaho does not publish a single age at which every new license becomes unrestricted. Daylight-only driving ends at 16, and the under-17 passenger limit lasts for the first six months after the license is issued.
County driver-license offices set their own appointment practices. The locations directory is the statewide page for finding an office; there is not one booking link for every county.
The pages opened do not say an out-of-state learner permit replaces Idaho's supervised instruction permit. They do waive the supervised period for new residents who already have a driver license.

gaps: Driver licensing is issued by the counties. The ages recorded here are the ages stated in the statewide driver manual and the state graduated-licensing brochure. No state page reviewed said those ages differ by county.

The state manual and online-test page do not print a statewide dollar fee. The online page says to pay the county fee by credit card. County fee schedules were not copied, so no dollar amount is listed.
There is no single statewide appointment link. The manual lists a separate scheduling page for each county.
The state manual requires a certified driver-education course with classroom and behind-the-wheel certificates. It does not state a numbered total of parent-supervised practice hours.
The manual's waiver language covers a valid driver license from another state. It does not clearly say an out-of-state instruction permit is accepted.

The full-license age of 17 is taken from the state graduated-licensing brochure. In the 2023 manual, the sentence that should state the minimum age for a driver license did not yield a readable number in the text extraction.

holding_quote: have held your learner's permit for at least six months

documents.summary: One identity document must show the date of birth and another must show a signature.
documents.quote: Two different forms that prove your identity

documents.summary: Proof of U.S. citizenship or legal presence is required.
documents.quote: Proof of U.S. citizenship or your legal presence in the U.S.

documents.summary: If the number is not already on file, the applicant must provide it, or submit an unexpired immigration document if ineligible.
documents.quote: Should your Social Security Number not be on file, you must know and provide it

documents.summary: Applicants younger than 23 must provide a birth certificate. An agency-stamped photocopy is acceptable; a notarized copy is not.
documents.quote: A photocopy with an embossed stamp of the issuing agency is acceptable, while a notarized copy is not

documents.summary: Applicants under 18 include a driver education completion certificate with the permit application.
documents.quote: Driver education completion certificate, and a Only for applicants who are under 18 years old

documents.summary: The license application list starts with proof of Maine residency, along with citizenship or legal presence.
documents.quote: Proof of Maine residency Proof of U.S. citizenship

real_id_summary: REAL ID is optional. A compliant Maine license has a gold star. A license without it is marked as not for federal purposes. After May 7, 2025, the non-compliant card is not accepted for domestic flights or certain federal facilities. The first REAL ID application is in person.
real_id_quote: marked with a gold star symbol on the face of the card
transfer_summary: A new resident must get a Maine license within 30 days. A person with a valid, or recently expired, license from another U.S. state or a Canadian province can convert it to a Maine Class C license and must present that license or a certified driving record less than 30 days old.
transfer_quote: You must obtain a new Maine license within 30 days of becoming a resident of the State of Maine
teen_summary: A learner's permit starts at 15. A license requires age 16, driver education, six months on the permit, 70 practice hours including 10 at night, and a road test. A license issued before 18 is an intermediate license. Passenger, nighttime, and phone limits last 270 days from issuance rather than ending on a fixed birthday.

teen_points.text: Learner's permit at 15 after the written exam. Under 18, driver education is required first.
teen_points.quote: To obtain a permit, you must be at least 15 years old and need to complete a written driving exam

teen_points.text: Supervising driver must be at least 20 and have held a license for at least two years.
teen_points.quote: accompanied by a supervising driver who is at least 20 years old and has held a license for at least two years

teen_points.text: License at 16 after six months, 70 hours including 10 at night, and a road test.
teen_points.quote: you must be at least 16 years of age and have completed an approved driver education course

teen_points.text: Intermediate restrictions last 270 days from the date the license was issued.
teen_points.quote: hold an intermediate license for 270 days from the date the license was originally issued

teen_points.text: A 16-year-old may drive in Maine on a valid out-of-state learner permit with a qualified supervising driver.
teen_points.quote: A 16-year-old with a valid out-of-state learner’s permit is allowed to drive in Maine

out_of_state_permit_quote: A 16-year-old with a valid out-of-state learner’s permit is allowed to drive in Maine
curfew: An intermediate license prohibits driving between midnight and 5:00 a.m.
curfew_quote: Operating a motor vehicle between the hours of midnight (12 a.m.) and 5 a.m.
passengers: An intermediate license holder may not carry passengers other than immediate family unless a qualified licensed operator is in the vehicle.
passengers_quote: Carrying passengers other than immediate family members

sources.title: I Moved to/from a Different State

gaps: A short Mozilla/5.0 user agent was blocked by the Maine site. These pages were retrieved with a full browser user agent and then checked against the downloaded text.
Unrestricted driving is not tied to a single birthday. The age-restrictions page says an intermediate license must be held 270 days before an unrestricted license. full_license_age is therefore null.
The out-of-state permit sentence specifically names a 16-year-old. It does not state a rule for a 15-year-old visiting with another state's permit.
The conversion-fee row on the fee page places the Class C and motorcycle labels and two dollar amounts in one flattened row, so those conversion amounts are not listed as separate fees.
The BMV Real ID page links out to an online scheduler that is not on a .gov host. scheduled_url stays on that official BMV page.
